## Experimental resident-session protocol and client hardening

Latest FE-027 implementation: `4fa23a66a12ed9cb92eb400be9b651825a3ac284`; final qualification evidence: `eda0e73fd2eca1c8d48caebf9d4d124232eb0d0f` (mask 63 passes all prior counterexamples, 4K twice and 8K; explicit opt-in, production unchanged). Previous release-gate handback: `ba11bd38a818c494634b06092215afe971f99ac1`; verified tooling: `120e993eead03fdae7ad5efbac9fe1583c250e7c`; N128/scalar cache identity fix: `0b49e08bb5948897a2b43774971213cdba0eec8a`; startup repair: `dc77d12c7691958750ff7cbbf8f635d7e29a262a`. Prior client evidence remains below. Production remains unchanged. **Keep this PR in draft; do not merge yet.**

- Existing strict create/continue/invalidation server contract retained; prior live matrices 7/7 and restart 5/5 retained without repeating expensive qualification.
- Native chat: structured HTTP/SSE JSON, bounded reads/timeouts, complete finish/DONE and Content-Length checks, no ambiguous or partial-output retries, atomic anchored/locked JSONL exchange commits, and durable pending legacy tool output with idempotent replay/manual retry.
- LM Studio 0.2.0 source/package under `clients/lmstudio-documents`: strict raw SSE, full document/history preservation, deferred validated tool completion, cancellation, and a separately tested scoped resident adapter. SDK 1.4.0 lacks verified stable chat identity, so the shipped SDK entry point deliberately forwards full history statelessly.

## Executed evidence

- Native client builds warning-free; **20 deterministic native transcript/fault tests PASS**, including actual tool pipeline with a compile-time no-shell stub.
- **19 generator/transport/protocol tests PASS**; TypeScript build PASS.
- Real LM Studio 0.4.26 build 4 document service + actual SDK Chat forwarding PASS (prediction controller/capture endpoint mocked; not GUI qualification).
- Updated native client live create/continue/forced-eviction/replay/quit/resume PASS on isolated port 11243: exactly 8 persisted turns, 1 automatic replay, correct ORBIT-73941 recall, no shell tools.
- Two short paired rounds and two 7,692-token document pairs PASS. Document follow-up: 25 newly prefetched tokens vs 7,702 stateless; median end-to-end 3.69s vs 308.80s. Exploratory/contended timings, not an uncontended throughput claim.
- Fresh short explicit full-history recovery median 2.80s; resident follow-up median 1.72s. Exact output match in tested cases.

## Remaining release gates

- LM Studio GUI Regenerate was inspected and is unavailable in the installed UI; this is CLOSED as an unavailable operation, not a failed or pending regeneration test. New-package GUI install/cancellation/attachment presentation are not inferred from the SDK/mock-controller tests.
- Do not enable SDK resident reuse without verified conversation identity.
- **BLOCKER: N128 accumulation FAILS at completed position 1920** under unchanged criteria. Short bounded results remain accepted only within scope. Named-profile HTTP restart, additional bounded fault contracts and selected short mode references now pass; larger contexts, all mode cross-products and real hardware-fault behavior remain unqualified. Canonical/resident histories retain their intentional empty-wrapper distinction.
- New-client independent near-limit 8K/long-context checks and actual approved shell-executor interruption remain untested; no production rollout recommendation.

Report: [engineering and exact commands](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/727def41819bc6dede52321cd2f020831a16f72b/docs/session-continuity-engineering-2026-10-25.md). Machine-readable evidence: `docs/results/session-continuity-2026-10-25.json`.

No production branch/binary, model weights or Qwen template changed. FE-027 now adds opt-in arithmetic alignment; default arithmetic remains unchanged. Selective execution compatibility version advances 2 → 3 for corrected lifecycle state; executable hashing remains disabled. No requests sent to 11241. Owned experimental server and continuous controls are stopped.

## Resident-state equivalence repair — 2026-10-27

Startup copied inactive CPU recurrent/conv shadows over the authoritative GPU prefix. Matched-token control localized the first divergence at position 13 across all 30 GPU linear layers. Targeted layer-0 GDN localization: 509,952/524,288 floats differ, max_abs 13.947830200195312, RMS 0.1325950803352789; actual tensor was zero. Removed the destructive upload and retained selective cache compatibility.

Seven bounded native matched-token cases pass exact component SHA256 comparisons: implicit 73 tokens, explicit 71, tools 415, thinking-budget 77 (15 substitutions), length-limited continuation 66, dynamic tool-prefix restore 415 (355 cached tokens), canonical/recreated history 69. All ten full-attention layer lengths match positions; no nonfinite state observed. Six model-free collector/history regressions pass. Hidden/logit scratch and allocation padding are excluded; instrumented timings are not performance evidence.

Canonical/recreated tokens and answers match exactly. Resident history contains the empty four-token thinking wrapper absent from canonical visible-history reconstruction; both paths match uninterrupted execution of their own token IDs. No template normalization.

[Full state-equivalence report](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/c35dc78be19bc9e4ba141252fe2cc300b8d30d40/docs/resident-state-equivalence-2026-10-27.md). Raw tokens and float dumps remain private in Drive. Keep draft; no production promotion.


## Bounded N128 and lifecycle qualification

Five short HTTP cases pass: scalar fallback at the batch threshold, minimum slab, slab + scalar tail/EOS/continuation, two consecutive slabs, and explicit system prefix from zero. Completed positions reach 304. Intermediate batch full-model states are not observed or claimed. Four numerical-oracle runs exactly reproduce EVERY observed HTTP candidate fingerprint, while scalar reference fingerprints match independent replay.

N128 is **numerically qualified, not bit-exact to scalar**, under the unchanged existing limits (state <1e-3; hidden <=1e-3; logits <=1e-2; greedy identity, finite values, exact KV lengths/mirrors). Across the matrix: max state 2.60353088e-4, hidden 2.28881836e-5, logits 9.48905945e-5. All ten full-attention and 30 linear layers checked.

Real client RST after partial N128 advancement and after a completed decode step invalidates the session, produces HTTP 409 on continuation, and permits exact fresh recovery. Measured diagnostic cancellation completion: 222.34 / 74.80 ms; health after invalidation: 0.65 / 0.47 ms. This is invalidation/recreation, not preservation of the interrupted conversation.

Native selected Zstd warm-state save/process-exit/load/restore passes exact fingerprints at prefix 141 and 64 subsequent positions through 205. Checkpoint 67,374,473 bytes; opposite mode and wrong prefix reject without altering valid state. Named-profile HTTP startup/restart integration remains separate.

The selective state identity now includes the N128 runtime switch. No executable hashing, kernel/template changes, format bump or production modifications. Existing prefix capture generally stays scalar; this safeguard does not imply observed production profile corruption.

[Full report and exact Mac reproduction commands](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/b3cc330124f6e574be940fbf67f049a1a61bfd65/docs/n128-resident-state-qualification-2026-10-27.md). [Sanitized metrics](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/b3cc330124f6e574be940fbf67f049a1a61bfd65/docs/results/n128-resident-state-2026-10-27.json). Raw token histories, floats and checkpoint remain private in Drive. All owned model processes stopped; production 11241 untouched. Keep draft pending architectural review.


## Architect decision and next qualification gates — 2026-10-28
Architect accepts **bounded** short scalar exact component-fingerprint qualification and N128 numerical qualification at unchanged source-defined thresholds; N128 and scalar are **not bit-exact**. Native persistent checkpoint restart and TCP-reset invalidation/fresh recovery are verified within their tested scope. **Production remains NO-GO; keep PR draft.**

Next experimental work is delegated in priority order: (1) long-context/many-slab N128 numerical accumulation and boundary testing; (2) real named-profile HTTP process restart/restore; (3) additional cancellation, transport, error-injection and disk-fault rollback; (4) other supported execution modes and selective-identity safeguards. Qualify by observed matched effective-token positions, finite state, KV consistency, greedy identity and established tolerances; do not change the Qwen template or weaken criteria.

[Architect disposition and detailed engineering gates](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/032eb94b4401ced1639aa83fcea3fc6be44d6fc7/docs/architect-release-gates-2026-10-28.md). Raw artifacts remain private. No production merge authorization.


## Four-gate engineering handback — 2026-10-28

**Production NO-GO. Do not merge; keep draft.**

| Gate | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Long/many-slab N128 | **FAIL**: first failing observed endpoint 1920; last passing endpoint 1792. 4K+ not launched after failure. |
| Named-profile HTTP restart | PASS: capture/save, process restart, exact shared observable state and behavior, stale session 409, prefix/version/compatibility/mode rejection and safe recovery in isolated storage. |
| Additional faults | PASS for actual half-close/client timeout, checked-forward prefill/decode injection and partial-write EIO preservation. Real hardware/OOM/Metal faults NOT ESTABLISHED; external tool execution is outside infer HTTP. |
| Other modes | Short within-mode exact state PASS for CPU-linear, legacy KV, unchained, nonresident MoE, o-proj V3 off, tiny-fast off and bypass ablation. CPU named-profile restart PASS. Ablation recall fails as expected; normal-model quality NOT APPLICABLE there. |

Error growth: state 2.39133835e-4 at 1792 → 0.967838436 at 1920; hidden 0.006615520 and logits 0.042357683 at failure. Greedy still agrees, KV lengths/mirrors remain exact and all state is finite; these do NOT override numerical FAIL. Limits unchanged.

Routing localization within the failing slab/layers 0–11: first observed expert-set change at layer 9, input position 1829. Scalar cutoff margin 9.53674316e-7 becomes a tie under N128; router max difference 3.33786011e-6. Executing only the last slab scalarly still fails. A diagnostic exact-scalar-anchor intervention reduces final slab state error to 1.08718872e-4, supporting upstream drift crossing a hard MoE routing boundary. This intervention is NOT a fix or qualification PASS. No kernel/routing/template math or serving policy was changed.

Confirmed tooling corrections: cached-prefix comparison respects actual observation coverage (0–39 capture versus 11–39 restored), strict missing/mismatched-point tests, bounded mirror/snapshot checks before reads, isolated caches and reproducible probes. Three coverage + six collector model-free regressions PASS; both isolated builds warning-free; mode identity and partial-write preservation tests PASS.

A different executable SHA restored the same compatible CPU test checkpoint exactly with no rebuild. Full-binary invalidation remains disabled; no compatibility/format version changes in this handback. Production and existing user profiles/checkpoints untouched. All owned model processes stopped; no requests sent to 11241.

[Consolidated handback and exact Mac commands](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/ba11bd38a818c494634b06092215afe971f99ac1/docs/resident-release-gates-2026-10-28.md), [sanitized matrix](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/ba11bd38a818c494634b06092215afe971f99ac1/docs/results/resident-release-gates-2026-10-28.json), [error curve](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/ba11bd38a818c494634b06092215afe971f99ac1/docs/results/n128-accumulation-error-curve-2026-10-28.csv). Raw tokens, routes, checkpoint data and log payloads remain private in Drive.

It is a planning record, not production approval. Update it as experiments advance; PR remains draft.

## FE-027 autonomous numerical investigation — 2026-10-28

Commit: `f6d2cf82727ea0a451bb961551080061e12e6882`. **MORE INVESTIGATION REQUIRED — no production promotion. Keep draft and unmerged.**

Measured identical-input inconsistencies: CPU versus scalar-GPU RMSNorm and shared SwiGLU; Q4 scalar V3 evaluates `fma(q, scale*x, bias*x)`, whereas grouped Q4 used `(q*scale+bias)*x`. The isolated mask-15 prototype aligns these operations with existing normalization/activation kernels and private grouped Q4 kernels, preserving batching geometry and routing policy. At the targeted first row, all expert gate/up/activation/down vectors, shared output and layer-0 output become byte-exact; first-token router inputs through layers 0–2 also match. This is local exactness, not general equivalence.

| Qualification | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Preserved ordinary-N128 reproduction | FAIL at 1920, unchanged |
| Opt-in alignment, original 2057-token fixture | PASS: state max 5.06043434e-4, hidden 2.71797180e-5, logits 9.05990601e-5 |
| Attempted 4K fixture | FAIL at 2304 after pass through 2176: state 0.568868160, hidden 0.007261276, logits 0.014543116 |
| Prior short two-slab resident history | FAIL at 303 during scalar continuation: state 0.363003731, hidden 0.093498230, logits 0.453935146 |
| Short threshold / minimum slab / slab-tail-EOS-follow-up | PASS; final explicit-zero HTTP case NOT RUN after regression |
| Native Zstd checkpoint restart | Exact fingerprints at all 65 observed positions, 141–205; wrong prefix/runtime mode/arithmetic mask reject; valid file preserved |
| Disabled experiment | Exact ordinary-N128 candidate fingerprints at positions 128 and 129; old compatibility identity preserved |
| Build / model-free checks | Four isolated builds warning-free; 14 focused model-free tests PASS |

All-layer localization distinguishes two mechanisms: layer 21/input 2237 crossing survives exact scalar rebase at 2176 (remaining within-slab arithmetic is sufficient); layer 33/input 302 crossing disappears completely when that scalar step starts from exact scalar state (inherited N128 drift). Counterfactuals are diagnostic only. Greedy tokens, finiteness and KV geometry/mirrors still pass at the failures and do not override numerical FAIL. Thresholds, Qwen template, top-K/tie policy and serving protocol unchanged. No reference-state-reset workaround.

Three alternating fresh-process non-diagnostic prefill trials per build: control median 34.289s (33.928–36.568), prototype 35.100s (33.493–36.246), 1024 measured prefill tokens of a 1025-token input. Observed +2.37% median time with overlapping ranges is exploratory, not evidence of a meaningful causal regression or benefit.

Selective compatibility retains the old identity for mask zero; enabled masks hash an explicit experiment version/mask and selected Q4 Metal text. Full-binary invalidation remains disabled; no ordinary format/execution-version bump or production changes. FE-001 remains BLOCKED and FE-027 ACTIVE. No 8K escalation after failure. All owned inference processes and isolated servers stopped; 11241 untouched.

[Detailed report, changed files, exact commands and remaining options](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/f6d2cf82727ea0a451bb961551080061e12e6882/docs/fe027-n128-arithmetic-investigation-2026-10-28.md). [Sanitized results](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/f6d2cf82727ea0a451bb961551080061e12e6882/docs/results/fe027-arithmetic-2026-10-28.json). [Error curves](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/f6d2cf82727ea0a451bb961551080061e12e6882/docs/results/fe027-error-curves-2026-10-28.csv). Raw histories, routing scores, float probes, checkpoint and timing logs remain private in Drive.


## FE-027 actual full-attention follow-up — 2026-10-29

Commit: `d1b8265f2edf85b49f2f844056f96abbaabd4f54`. **MORE INVESTIGATION REQUIRED. Production NO-GO; keep draft and unmerged.**

Actual layer-3 tensors at rows 0/1/7/30/31/32/63/127 distinguish inherited input drift from intrinsic preparation, attention/reduction and sigmoid-gating arithmetic. Identical-input Q/K/V projections and o-projection/residual replays are exact at sampled rows. CPU/GPU preparation max 1.90734863e-6; reference versus online attention max 2.08616257e-7. Every replay-to-live validation passes, and private replay preserves active state. Fused unavailable intermediates are explicitly unobservable.

Opt-in bit 16 (mask 31 with prior alignment) reuses scalar-compatible preparation/attention, preserves batched QKV/MoE and leaves scalar reference, routing, template and limits unchanged. Default remains off.

Do not stabilize routing or reset state periodically. All actual inference processes started by this task have exited; no new HTTP server or request to 11241. ## FE-039 — confirmed orphan-prefetch state defect and short repair (2026-11-02)

Repair commit `ac06b920dbb7e26b804480b36eea4dbe83b40d4e`. **Keep draft; release gates remain open.** Actual SDK multi-request testing exposed a second stateless N128 prefill with exact state through 128, then active-state error **18.87463927268982 at 129**. Authenticated layer-0 capture shows six omitted experts/zero weights; first-request and fresh scalar states match. The existing no-prefetch option isolates the cause.

Decode-prefetch flags leaked into N128 capture, which can return without consuming its short async read. The repair drains old writes/resets decode-only flags before request prefill and prevents capture-only prefetch launches. Default decode prefetch remains on. All captured active tensors/eight expert/combine vectors are now byte-exact, max error 0. Three stateless turns and three resident turns through 476 pass independent scalar replay. No routing/template/tolerance changes or state rebasing.

Eligible GPU N128 adds selective `nrow-prefetch-ownership-v2` compatibility; old prefetch on/off aliases invalidate once. Scalar/CPU identities, global execution v3, format/layout and disabled executable hashing remain unchanged. Unrelated future rebuilds remain compatible.

[Repair, negative/positive evidence and focused commands](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/ac06b920dbb7e26b804480b36eea4dbe83b40d4e/docs/prefetch-n128-ownership-2026-11-02.md). Earlier 16K/32K independent single-history passes and pre-repair long HTTP 150-position PASS remain valid for their executed scope; they did not establish this multi-request safety. ## Work A performance continuation handback

Started from9759b0265b64b51320ffb07166ff00d2f9ee483a. Final commit21a073174fb1feb828f2d28762293d1803e66a9a records the measured partial outcome. Checkpoints cb64c447/091f4b54/e8916033 preserve admission, staging diagnosis and the complete mask63 pair. Changes are confined to evidence validation/aggregation, regression tests, ledger and documentation. Frozen runtime/model/binary/fixture bindings were verified before launches. The existing repaired native32K/256-endpoint numerical PASS is reused.

### Measured prefill seconds

| Context | Mode | Cold | Warm | Warm tok/s | Complete process trials |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|16K|ordinary N128|1325.305|995.824|16.453|1|
|16K|mask63|1174.335|1180.462|13.879|1|
|16K|scalar|2123.869|2148.034|7.627|1|
|32K|ordinary N128, retained Nov6|3098.961|3145.699|10.417|1|
|32K|mask63, complete Nov10 pair|5128.867|5084.331|6.445|1|
|32K|scalar, completed cold request in interrupted trial|6741.074|INCOMPLETE|UNMEASURED|0|

Warm mask63 time cost versus ordinary is18.541% at16K and61.628% at32K. At16K warm throughput is1.820x scalar. At32K the cold-request ratio is1.314x scalar; scalar warm comparison is pending. Comparisons are exploratory n=1 and cross-date/cache confounded. Ordinary is a performance control. The earlier3580.765s interrupted mask63 cold observation remains outside complete-trial counts.

### Actual process outcome

The missing-case command ran11:19:29–17:19:28 PST. Mask63 starts11:19:31, completes cold12:45:32 and warm14:10:54, then exits through owned termination. Its accepted pair processes32768 prompt tokens, cached0,32 generated, with all10 KV lengths32800. GPU routing in all10 layers at32768 and CPU at32769 passes. Launch GPU6/19/15%, host47%, post14/12/14%; no guard event in this accepted process trial.

Scalar starts14:10:58 (GPU0/12/13%), completes cold16:03:52 and is interrupted during warm at observed position22144. The stop coincides with the configured six-hour phase deadline. The old exception path lost the watchdog return reason, so deadline attribution is based on bounds and timestamps. Original report remains STOPPED. Its completed cold SSE/usage/allocation evidence is retained separately.

A fresh scalar-only attempt starts17:31:52 under the existing4-hour process/6-hour phase limits and is rejected before model launch by GPU samples33–60%. A bounded settling window remains33–54%; final17:42:57 readings38/38/38%. This is a safe resource-admission block. All owned model/guard/supervisor processes and the test listener have exited.

### Environment and memory

Matched16384-token prefix host counters show linear staging49.686s→747.928s, with substantially smaller attention/projection changes. Memory Cleaner5.1 AutoCleaning=true was observed read-only. This supports cache/I/O conditions as a confound; causation is unproven. Phase counters overlap and are host-wall measurements. Hardware GPU timestamp latency and per-expert cache hits remain unmeasured.

Complete mask63 watchdog-observed RSS peak7,291,469,824 bytes, independent sampled RSS peak7,296,237,568, charged lifetime peak3,524,718,904, Metal5,357,207,552. Completed scalar-cold samples show peak RSS2,582,347,776 and lifetime charged peak3,567,820,360. Sampled peaks are distinct from unmeasured true lifetime RSS high water. These memory metrics overlap. Six-GiB reserve supervision supplements the existing admission/watchdog controls.

31 focused model-free tests PASS. The full validator requires both complete process pairs; split-phase support retains original STOPPED statuses and validates only independently complete rows. Cold must be repeated to establish same-process scalar warm state after exit. Exact scalar-only launch, reserve-guard and split-phase validation commands are in the report. No additional repetitions are scheduled under the quota constraint.

### Disposition

**BLOCKED — SAFE RESOURCE ADMISSION UNAVAILABLE**

A complete scalar32K cold/warm process trial remains the performance gate. The proposed envelope is M4/24GiB, tieredK8, opt-in mask63, default GPU-linear/chaining/prefetch/N128 and lazy32K. Production launcher verification, capacity enforcement, final integration and client reviews are separate approval requirements. PR #3 is draft. No merge/deployment actions are included in this work.

[Current handback and exact resumption commands](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/21a073174fb1feb828f2d28762293d1803e66a9a/docs/work-a-mask63-release-closure-2026-11-04.md)

[Review-only release procedure](https://github.com/KingdomDesignsConsulting/Flash-iOS/blob/21a073174fb1feb828f2d28762293d1803e66a9a/docs/work-a-mask63-release-procedure-2026-11-06.md)

Historical failed/interrupted results, admission blocks and numerical controls remain in the reports and Git history. Raw prompts/tokens/checkpoints and large records are private under /Users/knagel/Flash-iOS-Work-A/2026-11-04-mask63-release. Small driver logs use root benchmark-logs.
